prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a polished pixel art ART DIRECTION MODEL SHEET for an original Vietnamese-inspired fantasy MMORPG, Ngũ Mạch Huyền Ấn. The attached sheet is a design reference, NOT an edit target: preserve its character identity but dramatically improve clarity, anatomy, deliberate pixel clusters, elegant silhouette and restrained detail. Chibi Minh Kiem hero: spiky cobalt-blue hair, focused calm face, short crimson cape, teal tunic with ivory trim, gunmetal shoulder/hand/shin armor edged warm gold, hexagonal gold belt buckle, ONE broad golden sword with ONE small green hexagonal gem in its guard. Original design, no franchise emblems. Sheet layout on flat warm slate background: three large consistent full-body views FRONT, THREE-QUARTER FRONT, BACK across top, one expressive ready stance lower left, enlarged clean sword lower middle and 24-color palette swatches lower right. Large professional production concept board, not animation sprite sheet; no fake frame grid. Pixel art only, square stepped edges and tightly controlled clusters as if designed at 48x64 character resolution and enlarged nearest-neighbor; readable simple shapes, no airbrushing, no gradients, no glossy 3D, no random single-pixel noise, no excessively ornate armor, no huge cape hiding boots, no extra swords or limbs, no text except small simple view labels. Every view same haircut, proportions, cape clasp and sword gem. Feet clearly visible, slight top-down game-compatible view, 2.7 heads tall. Spacious editorial composition and beautiful crafted pixel art. This is visual concept reference, not final runtime art.

Use case: stylized-concept. Single professional ENVIRONMENT ART DIRECTION BOARD for original Vietnamese-inspired fantasy pixel-art top-down MMORPG Ngu Mach Huyen An. Landscape board with TWO beautifully composed distinct overhead gameplay dioramas, generous clear division. LEFT: BEN MUA rainy riverside village dawn, muted blue-teal shallow water with ripples, weathered brown wooden pier, small timber homes with red-grey clay tile roofs, bamboo baskets, reed banks, a safe stone footpath curving around the pond, two lanterns, a tiny courier silhouette for scale. A faint bell-shaped reflection in water but no physical bell above it, quiet magical mystery. RIGHT: THANG LONG vibrant capital daytime, patinated terracotta tiled roofs with subtle curved eaves, pale warm stone paving, a lively market with indigo/ochre cloth awnings, forge workshop, bridge over narrow canal, a broad civic square and modest central tournament stage. Vietnamese-inspired vernacular fantasy architecture, not generic Forbidden City palaces, no dragon overload. True top-down game camera with visible roofs and front wall faces, orthogonal streets, not isometric diamond perspective and not side scrolling. Both scenes have coherent navigable wide paths and readable prop footprints; roof and foliage mass at edges, open combat/navigation center, ground less detailed than silhouettes. Handcrafted deliberate crisp pixel clusters; consistent block size, limited colors, 16x16 tile grammar, clean clusters, no photorealism, no 3D rendering, no painterly smears, no smooth gradients, no random noise. Warm slate presentation border, bottom narrow material strips showing water, grass, stone, roof and wood closeups plus tiny palette chips. Only text labels BEN MUA and THANG LONG, no other text. This is a concept board for style and landmark composition, not canonical level topology, not final tile atlas.

Use case: stylized-concept. Make ONE polished pixel-art NPC AND CREATURE STYLE BIBLE BOARD for an original Vietnamese-inspired top-down fantasy MMORPG. Warm charcoal background, six isolated evenly spaced subjects in a 3 by 2 grid with generous negative space, a tiny palette strip beneath each. TOP ROW three consistent chibi human NPCs, each full body and a small side portrait: LY AN a practical young adult female courier, side-tied dark hair, short rain-blue jacket with ochre trim, large brown cross-body mail bag, a wax-sealed letter, boots, alert kind expression; TA VAN KHANH an adult male40-50, straight posture, dark navy wardens robe, bandage on left forearm, broken sword sheathed on his back, restrained tired expression; HA MAC adult scholar with paper-grey and ink-blue robes, neat tied dark hair, compact paper/map pouches, folding magnifier, curious attentive expression. BOTTOM ROW three enemies: CA LINH small turquoise silver fish spirit with reedlike fins, pearl eyes, recognizable fish silhouette and low hovering water shadow; RE NUOC compact plant creature with exactly three root legs and one curled whip vine, mossy olive and cyan sap; MANG COT larger moss-blue bone-scaled marsh serpent with ONE broken horn, expressive animal head, ivory plates and a curved low body, visibly wounded by magic but non-gory. Every figure original, clean silhouette and confident appealing proportions. Match handcrafted chibi pixel art drawn at approximately48x64 source pixel human scale and enlarged with square edges; monsters larger only for board readability. Clear large contiguous color clusters, 4 tones per material, strong dark contour, no random noise, no ultra-detailed embroidery, no soft rendering or 3D, no glows hiding form. Props readable at tiny game size. Avoid franchise designs and unapproved text/symbols. Use only short plain uppercase subject labels below each. A production CONCEPT board, not an animation sheet or ready-to-import sprite atlas.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished pixel-art MMORPG HUD AND COMPONENT ART DIRECTION BOARD, original Vietnamese fantasy aesthetic. Landscape composition. Upper 70 percent: a readable widescreen gameplay UI mockup over a quiet simplified top-down rainy riverside pixel-art map, a small blue-haired crimson-cape teal-tunic hero in center. Top-left compact circular portrait and exactly two dominant bars red HP and blue MP with small five-segment amber sword-intent pips, no duplicated fake stats. Top-right small square minimap with bronze border and plain label BEN MUA. Left-middle compact three-line quest tracker, bottom-left subtle joystick ring; bottom-right primary round attack icon with six numbered small skill slots in two rows, enough space to see ground danger. Thin gold XP strip at bottom. Theme charcoal-navy paper/wood panels, delicate old brass edges, teal selection accent, muted parchment text, deliberate hard stepped corners. No ornate giant filigree, no glossy glass, no modern gradients, no heavy blur, no neon glow, no smooth vector icons. Small concise plain UI labels only: HP, MP, BEN MUA, QUEST, BAG; no dense text paragraphs. Lower 30 percent on flat charcoal: component kit with a nine-slice frame, button normal/focus/disabled, six inventory slots with white-blue-purple-gold rarity border examples, potion icon, sword icon, quest-scroll icon, and a short row of three clean white-gold slash VFX silhouettes evolving startup/impact/resolve. Pixel art clusters read well at 640x360 logical; board is enlarged nearest-neighbor as a concept and layout guide, not working HTML or production sprite atlas. Prioritize clarity, spacing, consistent visual weight and beautiful handmade pixel UI. All effects and panel fills remain visibly pixel-shaped.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create a single elegant FIVE CLASS LINEUP concept board for original Vietnamese-inspired pixel art fantasy MMORPG Ngu Mach Huyen An. Use the provided generated hero board as a STYLE AND IDENTITY reference only: preserve first character identity, use matching chibi pixel clusters for everyone. Five evenly spaced full-body characters on one ground line, generous separation so weapons never touch, neutral charcoal background, tiny palette strip below each, no scenery, clear differences in silhouette, no dense armor ornament. Left-to-right: 1 MINH KIEM metal swordsman, spiky cobalt hair, crimson short cape, teal ivory tunic, gunmetal gold-trim armor, broad gold sword with small GREEN HEXAGONAL guard gem, composed focused face. 2 ANH DAO fire blade fighter, short dark brown hair, burnt-orange scarf, charcoal light layered leather, SINGLE curved dao saber, agile low ready stance, NOT a dual katana ninja. 3 HUYEN BUT water calligrapher, tied ink-black hair, paper-grey blue flowing but compact robe, ONE large calligraphy brush with dark wooden shaft, ink-blue tassel, one small water-ink ribbon rather than giant magic sphere, scholarly expression. 4 THACH CHUY earth guardian, stockier broad square silhouette, stone-grey and warm ochre layered heavy armor, ONE short broad stone-headed hammer, planted stance, face visible, no horns. 5 LINH CUNG wood archer, moss-green and cream short traveling outfit, dark hair tied back, elegant compact wooden recurve bow with leaf-shaped limb tips, quiver, steady alert stance, no antlers or fairy wings. Gender presentation varied, tasteful practical adult character designs, all approximately2.7 heads tall. Crisp handmade pixel art, clearly stepped silhouettes, large deliberate flat color clusters, strong readability at 48x64 source character scale, subtle highlights max4 tones per material. No smooth gradients, airbrush, 3D, copied franchise insignia, glowing aura swallowing silhouette, huge weapons hiding feet or duplicate limbs. Only plain short uppercase class labels, not stat panels. This is master visual direction and class differentiation reference, not spritesheet/runtime assets.
